entities.summary: Tunveer Mohyuddin Gillani is a Pakistani chess player and FIDE Master (FM). He is a multiple-time national champion and has represented Pakistan in numerous international chess events including Chess Olympiads, Asian Championships, and Zonal tournaments. He is one of the most prominent figures in Pakistan’s chess history.
